summary: Kenji is a cook and food-science writer, author of The Food Lab and The Wok, who tests and explains home-cooking techniques on video. He shares recipes through a Patreon community and co-designs knives, woks and pans with partners.

journey.title: Developed the reverse sear at Cook's Illustrated
journey.text: Kenji says he developed the reverse-sear method for steak while writing for Cook's Illustrated magazine. He says it has since become widely used.

citations.quote: This is a technique I developed for Cook's Illustrated magazine in 2006, first published in the May/June issue of 2007.

journey.title: Published a children's book
journey.text: Kenji's children's book, Every Night Is Pizza Night, had just come out when he promoted it alongside a charity knife sale.

citations.quote: my children's book which just came out every night is pizza night

journey.title: Released his second book, The Wok
journey.text: After calling it upcoming in 2021, Kenji was promoting The Wok as his new book by 2022.

citations.quote: my upcoming book The Wok
my new book, The Wok

journey.title: Turned his New York Times column into videos
journey.text: Kenji began making 'Ask Kenji' videos based on his column in the New York Times, including side-by-side experiments and live demonstrations.

citations.quote: This video is based on my newest Ask Kenji column n the New York Times.

journey.title: Moved full recipes to a free Patreon and added a dining channel
journey.text: Kenji began directing viewers to a free Patreon for full articles and recipes, and to an alternate channel for his dining content.

citations.quote: You can find the full article and recipe along with bonus content and my newsletter for free on my Patreon.
my alternate channel, Kenji Lopez Main, for my dining content

journey.title: Staged a live show, Tasting Notes
journey.text: Kenji produced a multi-sensory live stage show with members of the Seattle Chamber Music Society and local chefs.

citations.quote: Tasting Notes, my live multi-sensory stage show

journey.title: Started live Q&As with his team
journey.text: Kenji began answering Patreon members' questions in livestreamed Ask Kenji Anything sessions, holding his second live AMA, on woks, by March 2026.

citations.quote: We answered all of those questions in a live stream.
welcome to our second live AMA

journey.title: Launched the Kenji Eats Japan travel series
journey.text: Kenji and his team traveled to Tsubame-Sanjō in Japan with his knife-making partners to film the metalworking behind his knife.

citations.quote: The J. Kenji Lopez Alt team, we came to Niigata, Japan

ventures.title: The Food Lab
ventures.text: Kenji's first cookbook, which he describes as a large food-science manual with hundreds of recipes.

citations.quote: this is my sort of big food science manual a thousand Pages hundreds of recipes

ventures.title: The Wok
ventures.text: Kenji's second book, on the science and technique of wok cooking.

citations.quote: all about the science and technique of cooking in a walk

ventures.title: Every Night Is Pizza Night
ventures.text: Kenji's children's storybook about a girl who loves pizza, with a message about expanding your palate.

citations.quote: it's not a cookbook it's a story book it's great for kids 3 to 8 years old

ventures.title: Earlywood wok spatula
ventures.text: A wooden spatula for flat-bottom woks that Kenji co-designed with Earlywood. He says he makes no money from its sales.

citations.quote: I reached out to them and I said hey do you want to make a walk spatula together

ventures.title: Kenji x Vonhelmick knife
ventures.text: A limited-run knife Kenji co-designed with bladesmith Gordon Hanson of Vonhelmick, released in a batch of 100.

citations.quote: There are 100 knives available for purchase.
Gordon and I have been making this knife, the sheetoku knife, which is a knife that we designed together.

ventures.title: KAN x Kenji Shitoku knife
ventures.text: A mid-priced home-cook knife designed with Barney's company KAN. It blends a santoku shape with a chef's-knife tip, and a portion of each sale goes to hunger charities.

citations.quote: that's why we call it shitoku, which means four qualities

ventures.title: Our Place Titanium Pro pan
ventures.text: A non-coated, non-stick clad pan with a titanium cooking surface, made in collaboration with the LA company Our Place.

citations.quote: this one was a collaboration between myself uh and the company our place in LA

ventures.title: Our Place super-nitrided wok
ventures.text: A flat-bottom, super-nitrided carbon steel wok designed with Our Place to Kenji's specifications.

citations.quote: I made a wok!
We designed it according to my specs and it's sort of the wok I've always wanted.

ventures.title: Frienji of Kenji Patreon community
ventures.text: Kenji's membership community, with free and paid tiers offering recipes, livestreams and early access to product launches. Its annual Cookbook Club tier is tied to his next cookbook.

citations.quote: Become a Super Frienji of Kenji to get extra recipes, videos, essays, and more, including early access to product launches and discount codes.
